defs.def: sweet food eaten at the end of a meal （饭后）甜点，甜食

ex.s: Out comes a “soft-serve” creamy dessert, to be eaten right away.
ex.t: 出来的是一种"软冰淇淋"般的奶油甜点，可以立即食用。

ex.s: With a 3D printer， a cook can print complicated chocolate sculptures and beautiful pieces for decoration on a wedding cake． Not everybody can do that﹣it takes years of experience， but a printer makes it easy． A restaurant  in Spain uses a Foodini to "re﹣create forms and pieces" of food that are "exactly the same，" freeing cooks to complete other tasks． In another restaurant， all of the dishes and desserts it serves are 3D﹣printed， rather than farm to table．
ex.t: A．它帮助厨师创造新菜品。

ex.s: Lantern Festival celebrations In our restaurant, we offer Western dinners and desserts.
ex.t: 元宵节庆祝活动：我们餐厅提供西式晚餐和甜点。

ex.s: Commonly exchanged gifts include food such as fruit, sticky rice cakes, and homemade desserts.
ex.t: 常见的互赠礼物包括水果、糯米糕和自制甜点等食物。

ex.s: B an appetiser, a main course, soup, and dessert.
ex.t: B 一道开胃菜、一道主菜、汤和甜点。

ex.s: In other words, if you want to be healthy, you have to cut down on desserts, and cut out sweet drinks altogether.
ex.t: 换句话说，如果你想健康，就必须少吃甜点，并且彻底戒掉甜饮料。

ex.s: PAVLOVA By far the favourite dessert in Australia is the pavlova, which was named after the famous Russian ballet dancer Anna Pavlova, who visited Australia in the 1920s.
ex.t: 巴甫洛娃蛋糕 到目前为止，澳大利亚最受欢迎的甜点是巴甫洛娃蛋糕，它以20世纪20年代访问澳大利亚的俄罗斯著名芭蕾舞演员安娜·巴甫洛娃命名。
